action: @Pip leans forward, spots @GoldenStar under the mossy rock and flutters two tiny wings with excitement. @Tiggy crouches, slides a paw under the star and carefully draws it into the open.

audio: @Pip, bright curious chirpy childlike voice, 1-2s: {A golden star!} Soft sparkle tinkle.

camera: Hard cut to 65mm star close-up with @Tiggy’s paws; no changing focus plane during dialogue.

audio: @Mochi, playful warm high kitten voice, 11.2-14.5s: {A sky without stars? Oh no!} One small collective gasp.
end_state: All five understand the sunset deadline.

action: @Tiggy’s expression brightens with an overly confident plan. @Tiggy steps to center clearing and raises the star, while the other four clear a small safe space. Finish the final second with @Tiggy braced and the star held securely.
camera: Hard cut to 35mm full group from the established garden axis.
audio: Upbeat pizzicato pickup; tiny foot pats. No new spoken lines.
end_state: @Tiggy center, holding star; four friends in a semicircle beyond.
